_comment: Tool schemas exposed by the PaladinFi Swap MCP server at https://swap.paladinfi.com/mcp. This file is informational; the live server is the source of truth.

tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: Get a best-execution swap quote on Base (chainId 8453). Returns ready-to-execute calldata with a 10 bps fee already injected. Your wallet signs and submits the transaction; PaladinFi never holds funds.

sellToken.description: ERC-20 contract address of the token being sold (0x-prefixed).

buyToken.description: ERC-20 contract address of the token being bought (0x-prefixed).

sellAmount.description: Amount of sellToken in wei (integer string).

taker.description: Address that will sign and submit the transaction.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points. Defaults to 50 (0.5%).

tools.name: swap_health
tools.description: Get current service health, fee configuration, and supported chains. Returns the same payload as the GET /health endpoint.
